storage_contract_observations.identity: ApplicationSessionId, OperationId, RunId and StoredEventId validate canonical lowercase hyphenated non-nil UUIDs. storage_contract_observations.provenance_and_hash: Immutable creation provenance agrees with event 1 and original receipt/request, not renamed title. ring SHA-256 covers recursively key-sorted typed JSON; arrays and strings are unchanged, including encoded tool-output strings. This is not RFC 8785 numeric equivalence.
storage_contract_observations.transactions: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, receipt lookup before transition eligibility, validate whole batch, append contiguous events, update projections/head, save receipt, COMMIT. Known precommit errors are NotCommitted. Unknown commit results require lookup. Cleanup warning does not invalidate a committed receipt.
storage_contract_observations.creation: Catalog reservation, canonical session initialization, catalog acceptance, then response. No atomic two-database claim. Only known creating reservations can initialize missing/empty files. Accepted retries bypass availability while ordinary open remains fail-closed.
storage_contract_observations.lifecycle: OS-backed root lease, operation-owned task/guard, per-session mutation serialization and explicit connection close. Caller waiter drop does not abort admitted disk work. Close drains operations; uncertain retirement quarantines admission and retains lease until process exit.
storage_contract_observations.queries_and_repair: Fixed-head history range/LIMIT pages and catalog-only live ID-keyset listing hold no returned transaction. Explicit refresh reads canonical state and cannot promote bad availability. Explicit streamed repair validates history/run/tool projections and creation provenance, retains durable intent on interruption, and isolates missing/bad/duplicate claimants. Reopen lazily interrupts prior-instance nonterminal work once; no execution resumes.
